customManagers.description: Makefile tool pins tracked via inline `# renovate:` comments. Two matchStrings: (1) a bare semver value (PLANTUML_VERSION — Maven jar curl-downloaded by render-compare.mjs, so datasource=maven NOT docker: the plantuml Docker image carries 1.2026.3 while Maven Central only has 1.2026.2, the ADR-0003 incident — track the artifact the tooling actually fetches); (2) a full docker image:tag value (DRAWIO_EXPORT_IMAGE), capturing only the tag as currentValue. The allowedVersions packageRule filters PlantUML's legacy 8xxx Maven versions; the docker packageRule keeps the tag tag-only.

Keep the render-tooling scripts' PLANTUML_VERSION fallback default in lock-step with the Makefile (they MUST mirror — the Makefile recipe sets the env, the script literal is the no-env fallback). Same Maven datasource.
C4-PlantUML stdlib pin in the `!include` URL across every .puml fixture/sample and the docs/README that embed it. Tracked by GitHub release tag (plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML cuts vX.Y.Z tags).

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates

PlantUML on Maven Central carries BOTH the current 1.YYYY.x scheme and a legacy 8xxx scheme (maven-metadata <latest> resolves to the old 8059). Constrain to the modern dotted-year scheme so Renovate proposes 1.2026.x, never an 8xxx regression. Also keep it tag-only (no digest — it is a Maven jar coordinate, not a docker ref).
C4-PlantUML stdlib bump — open a PR but do NOT automerge: the parser's isComponent skip-list is kept in sync with a specific stdlib procedure surface, so a stdlib major could need a parser review.

Keep the Makefile drawio-export docker pin tag-only — config:best-practices transitively enables docker:pinDigests which would rewrite it to tag@sha256 and break the customManager regex (which expects a semver-shaped tag). The image is consumed via `docker run` at render time, which resolves the digest for the tag anyway. (GitHub Actions still get SHA-pinned via helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests in config:best-practices.)
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
